explanations.joint_gains: I raised everything, Kp, Ki, and Kd. I raised Kp to the max because it allowed the arm to reach its commanded position fast, and by raising Ki and Kd, I was able to reduce the recoil/swing every time the arm turns into a new position.  With this I hoped to create an arm that could cleanly swing into the right position.
explanations.gravity_comp: Gravity compensation seemed to make the arm more accurate to the commanded position, perhaps gravity was the biggest issue in putting the arm into the right position?

checkin.note: I increased Kp, Ki, and Kd to allow the arm to settle cleanly. I noticed that the arm was swinging very heavily after following its commanded position and increasing the Ki and Kd softened how much the arm swung. The Kp also seemed to increase the accuracy to its commanded position.
